paragraphs: He is the same as the unqualified R' Ami; see his entry.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman identifies the heading subject with the unqualified Ami and gives a cross-reference. The target title is abbreviated, retained as R'; this translates Hyman's assertion without an independent identity or catalog merge.
